outcome: Time to anesthesiologist arrival for epidural
Occurrence of general anesthesia for urgent Cesarean section
cohort: 575 women in labor from 12 maternity units in Israel
finding: Inadequate anesthesia workforce allocations may impair quality and safety outcomes in obstetric anesthesia services.
mod_finding: More than a fifth of unscheduled Cesarean sections received general anesthesia, and of these almost a quarter were attributed to delayed anesthesiologist arrival.
